name: Withering Bloom
summary:
Trapped within an endless dream, Nari, a humanoid being born from a mysterious bloom, struggles to awaken. Before she could take her first breath in the real world, a powerful entity sealed her inside her own mind — forcing her to dream, to suffer, and to forget.
In this surreal world, Nari fights through fragments of a distorted reality — facing relentless enemies and haunting obstacles. Each failure pulls her back to the beginning, forcing her to relive the same nightmare again and again.
But there is a way out.
To awaken, Nari must break the dream’s cycle and confront the one who controls it — the enigmatic Lady Beyond the Bloom, the creator of this endless loop.
Will Nari find freedom?
Or will she wither forever within her own dream?
